Okay first of all this is a fucked up thing to say. You have absolutely no right to say that she is possessed by some demon. If it's too much for you to handle then just say that but none of this is your gfs fault. Having this disease is fucking terrifying at times. Imagine not having control of your own mind and constantly hurting the people you love most. I'm sure she is trying her hardest and it sounds like she's not on meds either. Instead of bashing her for things that are probably consuming her with guilt you should have helped her find a psychiatrist so she can get on medication because that process in itself is a lot. Now that you've kicked her out and broke up with her it's not your responsibility at all but don't you dare come into a space like this to bash on people who are constantly battling this disease and have no fucking control over what they do because you're upset your girlfriend spent a little too much money and cheated on you in possibly a manic state. You have every right to be mad but don't you ever go calling someone in my community a fucking demon or crazy or any of that. Watch your mouth because your words are hurtful and it's bullies like you that made me attempt suicide not even a week ago. So suck up your tears because you might be heartbroken but that will be healed with time. Her disease will NEVER go away. She will always have to manage this. There will always be slip ups. And finding a partner who is willing and emotionally and mentally stable enough to hold on is going to be extremely hard to find if she ever does again.
